verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an official hosted MCP server at https://docs.asaas.com/mcp, with a Cursor configuration example and branch selection. However, its stated scope is limited to letting the assistant query the documentation and API reference, not to performing account operations such as charges or payments. Missing for 10: MCP tools that act on the Asaas API (creating or querying payments and customers), authentication guidance for agent actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Once this setup is complete, your assistant will be able to query the Asaas documentation and API reference.
To query another available branch, add the branch parameter: https://docs.asaas.com/mcp?branch=branch_name
